subject: Re: MediPlus - AWS Marketplace private offer (pricing, term, approvals)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@mediplushealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: MediPlus — AWS Marketplace private offer next steps

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and asks so we can push a private offer through the Marketplace:

- Pricing: you mentioned wanting to target a ~30% discount vs list given pilot/volume profile. We can propose a staged commit (year 1 credit + usage billing) or a straight committed usage line.
- Term: AWS private offers allow up to 3 years in our standard flow; you asked about 5-year economics. We can model both, but 3 years is the standard we can activate immediately.
- Approval path: please confirm who in your org needs to sign the PO (procurement + CFO + legal?) and whether DocuSign is acceptable.
- Evidence: AWS will want SOC2 evidence and an activation evidence pack for the co-sell motion. I’ve attached a draft PO and our SOC2 summary (redacted).

Can you share an email list of approvers and any procurement numbering required? I’ll loop in our co-sell and finance leads to align on the pricing model.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Exec — Marketplace & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
attachments: MediPlus_AWS_PO_Draft_20260809.docx, SOC2_Type_2_Report_redacted.pdf

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@mediplushealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MediPlus — AWS Marketplace private offer next steps

Stephanie —

Thanks, that recap is helpful. Procurement side:
- Approvers: Myself (procurement lead), Markus Braun (CFO), and Legal (cc’d via procurement alias).
- We typically prefer a multi-year agreement to lock pricing; 5 years would be ideal from our planning perspective, but we understand Marketplace constraints.
- DocuSign is fine.

Can you confirm what evidence is packaged for activation? We’ll need redacted SOC2, data residency confirmation, and a short one-page ops runbook for onboarding. Also, any co-sell enablement docs for AWS sales to reference would speed the process.

Elena
Elena Soto
Procurement Director — MediPlus Health
procurement@mediplushealth.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@mediplushealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MediPlus — AWS Marketplace private offer next steps

Elena —

Great, thanks for confirming the approvers. Looping in Jonas (finance) for pricing structure and Vivek (co-sell) for AWS enablement docs.

Jonas / Vivek: MediPlus is asking for 5-year pricing preference; AWS private offers standard max is 3 years. Can we:
1) Propose a 36-month private offer with an optional renewal credit structure for years 4–5 (subject to a new PO)?
2) Provide a staged credit in year 1 to match their pilot economics (reduces initial cash outlay)?

Also attaching an evidence checklist; Naomi, can you confirm the SOC2 redaction and runbook items?

Thanks —
Stephanie

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 11:34:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: MediPlus — AWS Marketplace private offer next steps

On Tue, Aug 10, 2026 at 9:08 AM PDT Stephanie Nguyen wrote:
> Elena is asking 5 years; AWS supports 3.

We should avoid carving non-standard long-term commitments into the Marketplace PO — that increases activation friction from AWS and delays buyer activation. Recommended approach:
- Offer a 36-month private offer (standard, quick activation).
- Include a Year-4/5 option inside our separate SaaS Master Services Addendum (MSA) outside the Marketplace that defines pricing ladders for renewals. This keeps the Marketplace activation clean while honoring the buyer’s planning horizon.
- For year-1 economics, we can provide a credit schedule: 40% offset applied to first 6 months, then standard usage billing. Finance is comfortable with this as a pilot incentive if we tie it to a minimum usage threshold.

I’ll draft the numbers once we confirm expected first-year usage.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@mediplushealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MediPlus — AWS Marketplace private offer next steps

Hi all —

Attached is the redacted SOC2 Type II report and a short evidence checklist (evidence_checklist.xlsx) that maps to AWS activation asks (SOC2, encryption at rest, KMS usage, audit logs). We can provide an ops runbook (1-page) that lists contact points, expected onboarding tasks, and KV-cache sizing guidance for pilot scale.

If MediPlus needs additional legal guarantees about data residency, we can include region-specific commit language but that typically moves the deal into the Private offering / VPC lane rather than a Marketplace PO. Happy to discuss tradeoffs.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
attachments: SOC2_Type_2_Report_redacted.pdf, evidence_checklist.xlsx

- We will need the final private offer doc (DocuSign enabled) and the activation evidence pack to route internally. Can you get the DocuSign envelope created this week?

Markus Braun
